description: This file implements socket and file handle emulation for Windows, providing functions for socket creation, connection, data transfer, and file operations, with internal handle management and error translation.

classes.name: FileOrSocket
classes.description: Structure representing either a file handle or a socket handle.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: Wrapper for Windows CRITICAL_SECTION for thread synchronization.

methods.name: gen_fd
methods.description: Generates a unique file descriptor number.

methods.name: handle_db_put
methods.description: Stores a handle (file or socket) and returns its assigned descriptor.

methods.name: handle_db_get
methods.description: Retrieves a handle by its descriptor, optionally erasing it from the database.

methods.name: set_errno
methods.description: Sets the thread's errno based on the last Windows socket error.

methods.name: sb_socket
methods.description: Creates a socket and stores its handle.

methods.name: sb_open
methods.description: Opens a file and stores its handle.

methods.name: sb_close
methods.description: Closes a file or socket handle.

methods.name: fsync
methods.description: Flushes file buffers to disk.

methods.name: ftruncate
methods.description: Truncates a file to a specified length.

methods.name: lseek
methods.description: Repositions the file offset.

methods.name: sb_fstat
methods.description: Retrieves file status information.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from a file handle.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to a file handle.

methods.name: sb_bind
methods.description: Binds a socket to an address.

methods.name: sb_listen
methods.description: Marks a socket as listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: sb_accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection on a listening socket.

methods.name: sb_connect
methods.description: Connects a socket to a remote address.

methods.name: sb_send
methods.description: Sends data over a connected socket.

methods.name: sb_recv
methods.description: Receives data from a socket.

methods.name: sb_sendto
methods.description: Sends data to a specific address using a socket.

methods.name: sb_recvfrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, capturing the sender's address.

methods.name: sb_setsockopt
methods.description: Sets options on a socket.

methods.name: sb_fcntl
methods.description: Performs control operations on a socket, e.g., setting non-blocking mode.
